import: byte-identical, no normalization or gain processing

sounds.title: 捞起玻璃瓶
sounds.description: 先有一团水离开水面，再落下两颗分开的水滴。
sounds.trigger: lifting 开始时播放一次；当前演出约开始后 0.8 秒进入此阶段。
sounds.edit_recipe: BSB 1534: body 0.023-0.205s, falling water 0.275-0.590s; short recorded details at 0.178-0.212s and 0.265-0.313s are placed as isolated drips at 0.57/0.75s. No glass collision or synthesized noise.

sounds.title: 拉开抽屉
sounds.description: 真实木抽屉的滑动与止挡，留住木腔的厚度。
sounds.edit_recipe: BSB 1499: splice 0.143-0.400s and 0.580-0.895s with 14ms crossfade, preserve end-stop; Kenney wood medium 002 at -16dB relative as initial handle contact.

sounds.title: 收起抽屉
sounds.description: 滑回以后，一声木头落稳的笃。
sounds.edit_recipe: BSB 1500: splice 0.330-0.500s and 0.820-1.100s with 14ms crossfade, preserving the real wooden close impact.

sounds.title: 展开托盘
sounds.description: 两次短而清楚的薄木轻碰。
sounds.trigger: 词条托盘开始展开时触发，当前动画约 0.22 秒。
sounds.edit_recipe: Kenney wood light 000/003, isolated short impacts, speed 1.30/1.13, 220Hz high-pass; two dry contacts at 0/0.072s; no scrape bed.

sounds.title: 收起托盘
sounds.description: 轻巧的落点与小回弹，没有连续摩擦。
sounds.trigger: 词条托盘开始收起时触发。
sounds.edit_recipe: Kenney wood light 000/003, isolated short impacts, speed 1.30/1.13, 220Hz high-pass; two dry contacts at 0/0.038s; no scrape bed.

sounds.title: 拿起信件
sounds.description: 偏厚、柔软的旧信纸，轻轻拿起的一小段纸声。
sounds.trigger: 用户点击信件并进入阅读时触发一次。
sounds.edit_recipe: Single bookFlip2 segment 0.046-0.257s, speed 0.82, HP 130Hz / 8-pole LP 2000Hz, 16ms soft attack and 55ms release. One gentle paper movement; no edge snap, extra impacts or synthesized noise.

sounds.title: 翻开配方书
sounds.description: 托住厚书封，整叠纸页轻轻分开，落稳。
sounds.trigger: 配方书开始展开时触发；当前相关展示代码名为 JournalBook，接入时核对映射。
sounds.edit_recipe: Cover dominates: bookOpen 0.014-0.143s at speed 0.72, HP75/LP1500; subtle bookFlip1 0.310-0.610s at speed0.84, HP130/LP1900 starts0.065s at0.22; low bookPlace2 0.034-0.175s at speed0.82, HP65/LP650 starts0.19s at0.16. Supported cover, restrained page block and soft settling body.

sounds.title: 合上配方书
sounds.description: 纸页收拢，留一个低而柔软的扑声，比打开稍重。
sounds.trigger: 配方书开始收起时触发。
sounds.edit_recipe: Subtle bookFlip2 0.046-0.154s at speed0.83 HP140/LP1700, gain0.10, followed at0.07s by bookClose 0.060-0.225s at speed0.78 HP65/LP1250 with14ms attack/60ms release. Soft low cover closure, slightly heavier than opening; no extra hit.
